name: Dong Chen
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong learned-control/physical-system fit with active soft-arm and agricultural-robot research. The public remote-intern route is relevant where an in-person eight-week appointment is unavailable.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 24, 2026 RL-ET-DeePC paper coauthored with his current PhD students Cheng Ouyang and Moeen Ul Islam tests a fabricated three-tendon soft arm, Arduino Mega 2560/Adafruit drivers, 12-camera OptiTrack and host-PC PPO inference. The learned policy decides whether to recompute DeePC or reuse a plan; it does not directly replace the low-level motor controller. Actual trials reduce optimization frequency by 34% with similar tracking, compared with a larger simulated reduction; hardware penalty settings are retuned. This is a real Mississippi State-led experiment, supported by the current group roster and lab news.

shortVisit.summary: Current team page explicitly invites research assistants at PhD, master’s and undergraduate levels and remote interns. It also lists an external graduate remote-intern alumnus, which is precedent only. Duration, compensation and 2027 dates are unspecified. Invitation text retains chendon9@msu.edu, an old Michigan State address; current homepage and official faculty directory provide Mississippi State contacts.
